key.name: home-app
key.description: The installed gaming home opened by Linux Gaming Mode. None keeps the ordinary desktop.

key.name: enter-on-login
key.description: Start the selected gaming home after sign-in. Has no effect when no home application is selected.

key.name: use-feral-gamemode
key.description: Ask the installed Feral GameMode service to apply its configured optimizations during a gaming session. Availability and effects depend on the daemon policy.
